subject: Sterren AP: vendor credentialing & PO / GL mapping
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@sterren.co>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, ap.ops@redwen-internal-monitoring@example.com
Cc: Sterren AP <ap.ops@sterren.co>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor registration - Redwood Inference (Sterren AP packet)

Hi Logan / Redwood AP team,

We are enabling Redwood Inference as a vendor in Sterren's AP system ahead of our first PO. Our procurement team asked me to request: vendor registration, a completed AP onboarding packet (bank details, tax reg IDs, remit instructions), and mapping guidance for how Redwood expects PO numbers, GL coding and VAT handling to appear on invoices.

Attached is our standard vendor packet (Sterren_VendorOnboard_2027.docx) — if you can return a scanned/filled form plus a PDF sample invoice with your bank details, that will speed things up. Also confirm whether you can accept an e-invoice XML or prefer PDF only.

We prefer vendor setup completed before PO issuance next week. Are you able to provide the requested docs by EOD Wednesday (14 Apr)?

Thanks,
Marta Lopez
AP Manager | Sterren Health
M: +44 7700 900123

Attachments: Sterren_VendorOnboard_2027.docx (form), vendor_requirements.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@sterren.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor registration - Redwood Inference (Sterren AP packet)

Hi Marta — thanks for the note and the form. Looping Karthik (Accounts Receivable) and Laura (Revenue Ops) to confirm requirements.

Quick summary of what we will return to you by EOD Wed:
- Filled Sterren vendor form (signed PDF) — see attached: Redwood_AP_Packet_Template.xlsx (we'll return a PDF copy)
- Bank details: wire routing + IBAN + Swift; we will provide both US and EUR remittance accounts as Redwood uses regional treasury routing.
- Tax evidence: Redwood is a US-headquartered entity (Redwood Inference, Inc.). We'll provide W-9 for US payers and VAT registration information for EU invoicing where applicable.
- Preferred invoice format: PDF invoice is standard. We can also generate a lightweight e-invoice XML (UBL) on request — please confirm whether Sterren's AP accepts UBL/Peppol or needs a custom XML.
- PO & GL mapping: please confirm whether your system enforces a GL per-line or per-invoice. If you require line-level GL, we will include GL code in a custom invoice field. If per-invoice only, include the GL at invoice-level.

A couple of things we need back from Sterren to complete mapping:
1) A sample PO (anonymized) showing the fields you use for PO number, release number and line IDs.
2) Confirm if you require net-30 / net-45 terms and whether early-pay discounts are applied at vendor level.

Action: I will attach the filled form and a sample zero-dollar test invoice once Karthik confirms bank details.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Manager, Accounts Receivable | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai
Attachments: Redwood_AP_Packet_Template.xlsx

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@sterren.co>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sterren AP <ap.ops@sterren.co>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor registration - Redwood Inference (Sterren AP packet)

Thanks Logan — attached is the completed vendor form from our side (Sterren_VendorForm_Filled.pdf) and an anonymized PO (PO-2027-004321) to show field mapping. A couple of clarifications from our end:

- We require a PO number on the invoice in the header and as the invoice line reference. The system will reject invoices without a matching PO.
- GL coding: Sterren can accept a single GL per invoice; if you include per-line GL we can map it but prefer invoice-level GL. Please indicate the Redwood GL code to map to the PO when you return the vendor packet.
- VAT: Sterren is EU-based. For Redwoods billing EU customers we will apply reverse-charge when Redwood provides a valid VAT registration; otherwise our AP will process VAT as charged.
- Payment terms planned: net-45 (our standard). If Redwood has different contractual terms, please flag ASAP.

We attached our internal onboarding checklist so you can confirm all fields. Can you return by EOD today with completed bank details and the sample (zero-dollar) test invoice? We will run authoring/validation and then enable your vendor ID.

Regards,
Marta Lopez
AP Manager | Sterren Health
Attachments: Sterren_VendorForm_Filled.pdf, PO-2027-004321_anonymized.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@sterren.co>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor registration - Redwood Inference (Sterren AP packet)

Hi Marta — thanks for the sample PO and the clarification. We completed the vendor packet and attached: Sterren_VendorForm_Filled.pdf (signed) and a zero-dollar test invoice PDF (zero-dollar-test-invoice.pdf). Summary of our responses and mapping guidance below: 

1) Vendor identity & tax
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Redwood VAT (EU): Redwood Inference B.V. VAT ID: NL999999999B01 (apply reverse-charge when Redwood provides customer VAT where required)
- US tax: W-9 on file for Redwood Inference, Inc. (will supply on request)

2) Bank / remit details (please use invoice header/Remit-To):
- EUR account (primary for EU invoice settlement):
  Account name: Redwood Inference B.V.
  IBAN: NL91RABO0123456789
  BIC/SWIFT: RABONL2U
- USD account (for US-dollar invoices):
  Account name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
  ABA: 021000021
  Account: 123456789

3) Invoice formatting and PO mapping
- Required header fields: Invoice number, Invoice date, PO number (PO-xxxxxxx), Redwood vendor ID (RW-000947).
- Place PO number in the top-right header and repeat it on each invoice line in the "PO Ref" column if available. Sterren will match by PO + amount.
- GL mapping: Redwood prefers invoice-level GL mapping. Please map Sterren PO field "Cost Center" to Redwood GL code: 6100 (Cloud Services). If your system requires a different field name, map to "account_code" or "gl_code".

4) VAT handling
- For EU customers where reverse-charge applies, Redwood will indicate "Reverse charge - Article 44" and include the Bermuda-style VAT note on the invoice header. If Sterren needs a specific VAT field in the XML, please share the XML schema.

5) Terms & early payment
- Invoice terms default to net-45 per your note. Redwood agrees to net-45 for Sterren. We are open to enabling early-pay discounting but need the discount rate and activation method from your side.

6) Test instructions
- Please enable vendor RW-000947 in your sandbox and validate the attached zero-dollar-test-invoice.pdf. Once validated in your inbound queue, reply with the vendor activation confirmation and we will route live invoices to ap@sterre-invoices.example.com.

We attached Vendor_Onboard_Confirmation.pdf showing the vendor metadata we submitted to your team. Let us know if any fields need different formatting.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Billing & Payments | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Attachments: Sterren_VendorForm_Filled.pdf, zero-dollar-test-invoice.pdf, Vendor_Onboard_Confirmation.pdf
